topography.project_purpose: Bridge Aggregator. Structurally: 286 project-authored contract(s) across 7 chain(s); 68 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 50 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20withpermit, checkpoints, authorizations). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
